statement:
You are given an array `prices` where `prices[i]` is the price of a stock on day `i`.

You want to maximize your profit by choosing a **single day to buy** and a **later day to sell**. Return the maximum profit you can achieve. If no profit is possible, return `0`.

**Example**

```
prices = [7, 1, 5, 3, 6, 4]
=> 5   // buy at 1 (day 1), sell at 6 (day 4)
```
title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
